concepts.def: Solves problems by storing solutions to overlapping subproblems to avoid recomputation.
Top-down DP: cache results of recursive calls so each subproblem is solved once.
Bottom-up DP filling a table iteratively from base cases to the target.
Property that optimal solution can be built from optimal solutions to subproblems.
Same subproblem appears multiple times - the trait that makes DP worthwhile.
Classic DP example; naive recursion is O(2^n) but DP gives O(n).
